t: .cmp{margin:10px 0 16px}.cmpt{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.cmpt th{font-weight:400;text-align:left;color:#6E6E6B;font-size:11px;padding:4px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #D7D7D4}.cmpt td{padding:5px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #E4E4E2;vertical-align:top;font-size:12px}.cmpt tr.me td{color:#1F2022}.cmpt tr.me td:first-child{border-left:2px solid #CC746C}
abbr.gl{text-decoration:underline dotted;text-underline-offset:2px;cursor:help}

.rpages{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;margin:12px 0}.rpage{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #E4E4E2,0 4px 14px rgba(31,32,34,.06);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}.rpage svg{display:block}

.f1r-more{margin:8px 0 4px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:#4A4D52}.f1r-more .lb{margin-top:6px}.f1r-more p{margin:2px 0 4px}.f1r-more table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}.f1r-more td{vertical-align:top;padding:2px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid #ECECEC}

.f1c-eng-a-set{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 18px;align-items:center;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--f-ink2);margin:0 0 14px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--f-hair)}.f1c-eng-a-set input{width:64px}.f1c-eng-a-set .m{color:var(--f-mute)}.f1c-eng-a-set .g{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}.f1c-eng-a-set .g .m{margin-right:4px}.f1c-eng-a-set button{font:inherit;padding:3px 9px;border:1px solid var(--f-rule);background:#fff;color:var(--f-ink2);cursor:pointer}.f1c-eng-a-set button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--f-ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--f-ink)}
